data.one_liner: A unified Flutter widget for playing videos from YouTube, Vimeo, network, and local files.
data.what_it_does: omni_video_player is an all-in-one Flutter video solution wrapping specialized extractors and webviews into a single controller. It handles YouTube, Vimeo, HLS, local assets, and network sources with smart fallback options and built-in quality selectors.
use_when: You need to play videos from multiple sources like YouTube, Vimeo, and HLS using a single controller.
You want built-in UI features like quality selection, playlists, and responsive video scaling.
avoid_when: You only need basic local file playback and want to minimize dependency size.
You are building for platforms or formats unsupported by the underlying extractors (e.g. certain WebM constraints on iOS).
strengths: Unified API across YouTube, Vimeo, HLS, and local video sources.
Automatic WebView fallback for YouTube when primary extraction fails.
Built-in quality selection for YouTube and HLS streams.
Playlist support for queuing multiple videos.
weaknesses: Quality selection for YouTube is limited or disabled on iOS due to native stream limitations.
WebM seeking is disabled on iOS due to WebKit limitations.
data.setup_notes: Optional configuration for Android INTERNET permission and cleartext traffic, or iOS arbitrary loads if using HTTP streams.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic official video playback without extra features like YouTube extraction, Vimeo support, or built-in quality selectors.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary focus is advanced audio playback or complex audio streaming rather than video.
